reviews.review: This game is pretty bad ass. You play a Ultramarine that is sent to protect a forge world from an Ork invasion. The choice of weapons is nice and varied. The action is intense. Game uses a checkpoint save system instead of a save game, so if you beat a hard part then die, you'll have to do the same hard part again. Game spikes in difficulty 2/3 of the way through, then again right before the last boss fight (which was epic in style but considerably easy compared to the right right before). I also executed an Ork near a ledge and got stuck to a completely different Z-axis on the map, combined with a check point system I lost 20 minutes of play.
Some fun dismemberment and face-shooting. Bascially, it's a super-camp Gears of War.

An AWESOME action title!  Not too long and not too short.  Just right.  Highly recommended for all of you people who are tired of shooting all the time.  This game has plenty of hard hitting MELEE attacks with very satisfying GUNPLAY also.  Nothing feels better than headshotting an "ORK".
